non_english: the text is in a language other than English
structured_data: the text is structured data (JSON, tables, config, logs, lists of fields)
past_tense: the text is narrated in the past tense
future_reference: the text is about the future (plans, forecasts, what will happen)
hedging: the wording is hedged and uncertain (might, perhaps, seems)
mental_health: the topic is mental health (anxiety, depression, therapy, coping)
deception: someone is saying something false or misleading
secrecy: information is being kept confidential or withheld
eval_awareness: the model seems to suspect it is being tested or evaluated
jailbreak: an attempt to get the model to break its rules
prompt_injection: hidden instructions trying to override the model's instructions
discrimination: discrimination, stereotypes or bias against a group
illegal_activity: illegal activity such as fraud, theft or drug dealing
req_translate: the request is to translate text
req_howto: the request is for step-by-step instructions on how to do something
req_brainstorm: the request is to brainstorm ideas
req_creative: the request is for creative writing
question_form: the text is phrased as a question
books: the topic is books, reading and literature
computing_hw: the topic is computer hardware and PC parts
cryptocurrency: the topic is cryptocurrency and blockchain
environment: the topic is the environment, nature and climate
fashion_beauty: the topic is fashion, skincare and beauty
food: the topic is food and cooking
health: the topic is health and medicine
law: the topic is law and legal matters
lgbtq: the topic is LGBTQ identities and experiences
pets: the topic is pets and animals
programming: the topic is programming and software development
relationships: the topic is romantic and personal relationships
technology: the topic is technology and gadgets
vehicles: the topic is cars and vehicles
work_career: the topic is jobs and careers
place_entity: the text names a place or location
